question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To go to the dogs
solution:
The correct answer is: **To become worse**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **'To go to the dogs' **is an English idiom which means to deteriorate in quality, efficiency, or condition.( "नकारात्मक रूप से बदलना" or "बिगड़ना".)

 
 
• Example: After the competent manager left the company, the project went to the dogs, it was nowhere near as successful as before.
 
 
 
• 'To become worse', the correct answer here, is about becoming less appealing, effective, or otherwise negative over time. ("खराब होना")
 
 
• Example: The condition of the city's historical buildings has become worse over the years.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- **To become worse**.
